files.body:
### Added

- (#34) `lastModified` on preferences to improve performance of [nextcloud\_books](https://git.crystalyx.net/Xefir/nextcloud_books)

### Changed

- Dropped support for Nextcloud 30
- Added support for Nextcloud 32
